issues.description: The template's Farm implementation is inconsistent with the problem statement and solution: the file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java declares a public class named AnimalFarm (and contains duplicated/malformed nested content and an extra package declaration inside a method), whereas the problem UML and the solution expect a public class named Farm. This will cause compilation errors (public class name doesn't match file name) and prevents students from implementing or testing the Farm API as specified.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the contents of src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java in the template with a correct public class Farm implementation (matching the UML and solution): remove the erroneous 'AnimalFarm' class and any nested/duplicated package declarations, ensure the file declares 'public class Farm' and the expected fields/methods (animals list, constructor, addAnimal, feedAllAnimals, singFarmSong, etc.). Ensure the public class name matches the filename Farm.java so the project compiles.
